title: core.person
description: A member of an academy (person + tenant roles + login). Key `<tenantId>:<personId>`. Deactivating a member is a `person.changed` with `active` false; deleting a person record emits `person.removed` (empty payload: the aggregate id is the identity), then a tombstone (null value) for the same key. Envelope common to every core topic (libs/contracts/README.md, section Events): published by core's outbox publisher, at least once, in outbox order per key; consumers ignore a known `eventId` and never let an older `occurredAt` overwrite a newer one.

eventId.description: Unique per event (the outbox row id); the same id on every redelivery.

version.description: Major version of the topic's contract (a breaking change is a new topic `<topic>.v2`).

tenantId.description: The academy the event belongs to; consumers bind it per event.

aggregateId.description: Id of the aggregate; the Kafka key is `<tenantId>:<aggregateId>`.

PersonChanged.description: The member's current state (state transfer: the latest event per key is the whole aggregate).

displayName.description: Given and family name, separated by one space.

oneOf.description: Keycloak `sub` of the linked login; null while the member has no login.

active.description: False once the member is deactivated.

PersonRemoved.description: The person that was deleted: the aggregate id is its identity, nothing else is sent.
